description:
Deadly diseases like Ebola, plague and smallpox are still being kept alive in laboratories around the world. Why do scientists preserve these dangerous pathogens, and what happens when something goes wrong? Explore the research, past laboratory accidents, biological weapons programmes and risks behind humanity’s uneasy relationship with these microscopic threats.
